title: Signed Array Subarray Sum
input_format: The first line contains n and k. The second line contains n integers a1..an, which may be zero, positive, or negative.
output_format: Print a single integer: the number of subarrays whose sum is exactly k.
notes: Values may be negative, zero, or positive.
This task is the signed counterpart to T01 and intentionally invalidates sliding-window logic.
